title: All in One Vietnam with FREE Nha Trang Island tour
highlights: From Hanoi to the Mekong Delta and Nha Trang, unleash your adventurous spirit by trekking, cruising, and exploring the diverse landscapes of Vietnam.
Unwind and relax on a Halong Bay cruise, kayaking through hidden bays and swimming in pristine waters.
Explore the intricate stone carvings of My Son Sanctuary and relax on a peaceful boat ride along the Thu Bon River.
Immerse yourself in the history of Vietnam at the War Remnants Museum, where powerful exhibits tell the story of the nation's struggle.
Embark on an island-hopping adventure with a visit to Mun, Mot, and Hon Tam Islands in the Nha Trang Bay region.

know_before_you_go: Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.
The display prices mentioned are subject to change and are for a minimum of 2 PAX for standard, deluxe, and super deluxe properties.

ID Proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and upon arrival. PAN Card will not be considered as a valid identity proof. All foreign nationals must carry their passport as a proof of identity.
The official currency of Vietnam is the Vietnamese Dong (VND). It’s advisable to carry some cash for small purchases, though credit cards are widely accepted.
It is advisable that you dress modestly (keeping your upper arms, shoulders, knees, and legs covered) when visiting any religious sites.
Indian tourists can obtain a Vietnam visa online (E-Visa) or upon arrival at the airport with a validity of 30 days. Charges have to be paid by the tourists.
Smoking is prohibited in most public areas therefore, designated smoking areas should be used.
Always carry tissue paper or wet wipes with you as most public toilets in Vietnam do not provide them.
To mitigate health risks, it is strongly advised to refrain from drinking tap water directly in Vietnam. Instead, carry refillable water bottles.
Images are only for representation purposes.

In cases of force majeure events (e.g., natural disasters, political unrest, or other unforeseeable circumstances), [Thrillophilia] reserves the right to reschedule tours & treks or offer alternative itineraries to ensure the safety and well-being of clients and staff.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the stay property will be charged at actuals.
Kindly do not litter and help keep the destinations clean.
Please note that the timings and duration of pick-up and drop-off transfers may vary based on certain factors like traffic, weather conditions, natural calamities, etc.
Prices may fluctuate with any change in services/hotels. The difference in the cost shall be borne by the client in case of any amendment in the package due to an increase in the number of guests.

If in case any traveller wants to or decides to leave the trip in the middle, all the expenses from the point onwards will be borne by the traveller. Neither the operator nor Thrillophilia will be held responsible for such decisions or for any refund.
It is recommended that you purchase travel insurance. Please note that the travel insurance is not included in the package price.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Leisure Day
days.desc: Commence your Vietnamese adventure with an arrival at the Noi Bai International Airport, followed by a pre-booked transfer to your hotel for check-in. Relax and unwind before immersing yourself in the vibrant energy of Hanoi. Explore the city's nearby markets and nightlife on your own. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hanoi City Tour
days.desc: On this day, board the provided transfers for a city tour of Hanoi, starting with a visit to the Tran Quoc Pagoda, Hanoi's oldest temple. Continue to the Ho Chi Minh Complex, exploring the historic residence and mausoleum of the nation's beloved leader. Witness the unique architectural marvel of the One Pillar Pagoda, followed by a leisurely stroll across the iconic Huc Bridge leading to the Ngoc Son Temple. After exploring a few more attractions, get driven to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Get ready for a cruise adventure after checking out of the hotel and getting transferred to Halong Bay. Upon arrival, embark on a Halong Bay cruise at Tuan Chau Harbour. Stop by Ti Top Island and Pearl Farm Village to enjoy recreational activities like kayaking and swimming. Conclude your day with an overnight stay in the cabin as the cruise glides through the limestone karst (hollowed rock formations) and pristine waters of Halong Bay.

days.desc: Commence your day with a delightful buffet breakfast while cruising through the bay. Learn the secrets of Vietnamese cuisine with an onboard cooking class before deboarding and getting transferred to Hanoi Train Station. From there, take the train for an overnight journey to Sa Pa.

days.title: Excursion to Sa Pa | Leisure Day
days.desc: Upon arrival at the Sa Pa Train Station in the morning, get transferred to your hotel and check in. Set out for a trek to Cat Cat - Sin Chai Village, where you can explore and experience the local community’s lifestyle. Trek back to the hotel and spend the evening at leisure wherein you can visit Sa Pa Market to try some local delicacies and shop for souvenirs. Return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.desc: Embark on a thrilling trek to Lao Chai – Ta Van village, immersing yourself in the local culture and stunning landscapes. Stroll through the village, interacting with the locals and gaining insights into their daily lives. Trek back to the hotel, check out, and board the train from Sa Pa Train Station for an overnight journey to Hanoi.

days.title: Transfer to Da-Nang | Transfer to Hoi An | Leisure Day
days.desc: Upon arrival at Hanoi Train Station in the morning, get transferred to Noi Bai International Airport for your flight to Da Nang International Airport. After reaching Da Nang, get driven to the hotel and check in. Spend the rest of the day at leisure by exploring Hoi An's Night Market, indulging in delicious street food and unique shopping experiences. Also, embark on a boat ride through the Bay Mau Coconut Forest. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: My Son Holyland Sanctuary Tour
days.desc: Take the provided transfer from the hotel to explore My Son Sanctuary, a UNESCO World Heritage Site with its intricate stone carvings and ancient ruins. Gain insights into the Champa civilization, culture, and traditions before embarking on a serene boat ride (at an extra cost) along the Thu Bon River, offering breathtaking views of the countryside. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hoi An | Leisure Day
days.desc: On this day, check out of your Hoi An hotel and get transferred to Da Nang International Airport for your flight to Cam Ranh International Airport. Upon arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check in to relax for a while. Spend the afternoon at leisure exploring the beautiful beaches of Nha Trang, including City Beach and Hon Chong Beach, on your own. Later, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Nha Trang Island Tour
days.desc: Embark on an island-hopping adventure, commencing at Cau Da Port as you get transferred from the hotel. Explore the pristine beaches and vibrant coral reefs of Mun Island before sailing (at an extra cost) to the serene shores of Mot Island, renowned for its tranquil ambiance. Immerse yourself in the crystal-clear waters, engaging in water sports, and relaxing on the beaches of Hon Tam Island. After the adventure, get dropped off at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day
days.desc: Take this day to explore Nha Trang on your own by visiting Po Nagar Temple, dedicated to the worship of the Cham goddess Anapan, and immerse yourself in the serene ambiance of the Long Son Pagoda, renowned for its iconic White Buddha statue. After a fun-filled day, head back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

meals_hotel.location: Emerald Bay Hotel & Spa Nha Trang

days.title: Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City | Leisure Day
days.desc: Today, check out of the Nha Trang hotel and get transferred to the Cam Ranh International Airport for your flight to Tan Son Nhat International Airport. Upon arrival, get driven to check in at your hotel and set out to explore the city. Pay a visit to the Thien Hau Temple, a testament to the Chinese influence in Vietnam. Also, experience the thrill of Suoi Tien Theme Park, with its diverse range of rides and other attractions. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Ho Chi Minh City Tour | Leisure Day
days.desc: Start by getting transferred for a tour of Ho Chi Minh City. Visit Notre Dame Cathedral, famous for its iconic twin towers and stained glass windows. Learn about the Vietnam War at the War Remnants Museum with its exhibits and artefacts. Also, explore the Reunification Palace and Saigon Central Post Office before getting driven to the hotel. You can also visit places like Saigon River and Dong Khoi Street on your own, before returning to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mekong Delta Day Tour
days.desc: Prepare yourself for an exciting experience of a sightseeing tour in the Mekong Delta. During this day trip, spend some time at Ving Trang Pagoda, followed by a boat ride in My Tho. Also, enjoy a visit to Tortoise Islet and its various fruit orchards. In the evening, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day
days.desc: Spend this day exploring the remaining iconic attractions of Ho Chi Minh City at your leisure. Learn about the cultural significance of Vinh Nghiem Pagoda and Mariamman Hindu Temple, dedicated to the Vietnamese Buddhist and Tamil Hindu communities, respectively. For a fun-filled outing, visit the Saigon Zoo and Botanical Gardens, home to over 120 animal species and over 260 plant species. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: As your incredible 16-day journey through Vietnam comes to an end, it's time to prepare for the departure. Check out from the hotel in Ho Chi Minh City and get transferred to the Tan Son Nhat International Airport for your flight. Have a safe journey ahead!
